A decoder turns a score row into a next token. Greedy chooses a local maximum, sampling draws from a distribution, and beam search carries several prefixes. The resulting token becomes part of the next input. Our experiment emits text; executing an infrastructure action would need its own authorization and checks. We will calculate the policy before judging the complete answer.

At each position, the model supplies a conditional distribution given the prompt and every generated token so far. Multiply those conditional probabilities along a path to obtain its joint probability. Adding log probabilities gives the same ranking while avoiding long products of tiny numbers. A direct stable log-softmax can retain a log probability even when its ordinary probability underflows.

A fixed horizon with vocabulary size V and T positions has V to power T possible paths. Three choices for three positions already give twenty-seven paths. The article’s hypothetical thirty-two-thousand-token vocabulary over one hundred positions gives about three point two seven times ten to power four hundred fifty. These are completed length-one-hundred paths, not every intermediate tree node. EOS and constraints change which sequences are eligible.

Viterbi can merge histories that have the same compact future-relevant state. General transformer prefixes usually retain different future distributions, so merely keeping a full prefix or KV cache does not merge that tree away. Ancestral sampling takes a different route: draw one conditional token at a time. In ideal arithmetic that samples the model’s joint law without enumerating paths or locating its highest-probability sequence.

Return to the rotation prompt. Its supplied logits are three for create, two point five for revoke, one for rename and negative one for quota. A logit is a score, not a probability. Negative scores are permitted, and the scores do not sum to one. Predict which token has the largest probability before we convert the row.

Subtract the largest score from every entry, then exponentiate. The shifted scores are zero, negative point five, negative two and negative four. Dividing each resulting weight by their sum gives probabilities about point five six eight, point three four five, point zero seven seven and point zero one zero. The common factor introduced by the shift cancels between numerator and denominator.

Create is the mode, but a weighted draw can choose revoke. On the cumulative probability strip, the supplied uniform draw point seven five lands in revoke’s interval. That is one next-token event. It is not a measured probability that a whole answer is wrong, an operation executes or a service fails. Later tokens and complete-answer grading still matter.

Now supply logits one thousand, nine hundred ninety-nine and nine hundred ninety-eight. Direct exponentiation overflows ordinary floating-point math. Subtracting the maximum leaves zero, negative one and negative two, whose exponentials fit and produce about point six six five, point two four five and point zero nine zero. This operation preserves the mathematical distribution; it changes the numerical route.

An extreme negative gap can still underflow its probability to zero. Taking a logarithm after that rounding cannot recover the original finite log probability; calculate log-softmax directly when you need that quantity. Negative infinity deliberately masks a token. If every token is masked, this lab rejects the row rather than dividing zero by zero. Its actual code also rejects NaN and positive infinity.

The fixture uses ordinary words and supplied probabilities, so every branch can be checked. Treat each word as one token and Mia as the fixed prompt. We will expand for four generated tokens, counting EOS, and keep completed answers separate from the active beam. We prune unfinished paths by cumulative log probability, breaking ties alphabetically, then compare the scoring rules used for completed answers.

Given the same prefix, the model assigns mass across its next-token choices. Opened receives the largest share, looked receives a little less, and slept receives the smallest. These supplied toy probabilities let us trace each branch.

A complete path needs another conditional choice after every unfinished word. Multiply the edge probabilities along one path to obtain its joint probability. In log space, add each edge's log probability and keep the same ranking without tiny repeated products.

A period and an end-of-sentence token have different meanings in a tokenizer. We will use the explicit EOS marker for completion, so the search knows exactly when a candidate stops and how many generated tokens its score includes.

Beam search keeps a small set of active prefixes. At the first step, width two retains opened and looked. The shorter route beginning with slept falls below the cutoff, so later steps cannot extend that route in this run.

Notice what the width controls. It is the number of partial sentences carried between steps. The model still scores possible next tokens, and the search still compares cumulative path scores before deciding which prefixes remain active.

A beam acts like a narrow moving frontier through the tree. Its surviving leaves are promising under scores seen so far. The frontier is a compute budget, and pruning makes the procedure an approximation to searching every sequence.

A generation receipt records model and runtime, prompt and retrieved evidence, policy settings and processor order, grammar version, seed and stop reason, plus the source of task judgments.
